sentences.ko: 아 진짜, 너네 둘 때문에 더는 못 참겠어.
sentences.text: Okay, I've had it up to here with you two.

alts.text: Seriously, I'm so done with you two.
I have completely run out of patience with the two of you.

sentences.note: **I've had it up to here**는 손을 목 높이까지 올리며 '참을 만큼 참았다, 이제 더는 못 참겠다'고 할 때 씁니다. 더 편하게는 **I'm so done with**라고 해요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 어느 나이가 되면 룸메이트랑 같이 사는 건 좀 없어 보이는 것 같아.
sentences.text: I think you reach a certain age, having a roommate is just kind of pathetic.

alts.text: Past a certain age, having a roommate's kinda sad.
Once a person reaches a certain age, I believe having a roommate is rather pathetic.

sentences.note: **reach a certain age**는 나이를 콕 집지 않고 '어느 정도 나이가 되면'이라고 돌려 말할 때 씁니다. **kind of pathetic**은 '좀 한심하다, 없어 보인다'를 살짝 누그러뜨린 말이에요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.ko: 그 얘기는 너희 중에 누가 결혼하면 그때 하자.
sentences.text: How about we have this conversation when one of you guys gets married?

alts.text: Save it for when one of you actually gets married.
Perhaps we could discuss this once one of you is married.

sentences.note: **How about we** 뒤에 동사를 붙이면 '~하는 게 어때?'라는 제안인데, 여기처럼 '지금은 그 얘기 그만하자'고 은근히 미룰 때도 씁니다. **Save it for**는 '그 얘긴 ~때까지 아껴 둬'라는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 난 세상에서 제일 맛있는 초코칩 쿠키 굽는 엄마는 못 되려나 봐.
sentences.text: I guess I'm not going to be the mom who makes the world's best chocolate chip cookies.

alts.text: Guess I won't be the mom with the world's best cookies, then.
It seems I will not be the mother who bakes the finest chocolate chip cookies in the world.

sentences.note: **I guess I'm not going to be**는 '~는 못 되겠네' 하고 기대를 내려놓으며 멋쩍게 웃을 때 씁니다. **the world's best**는 '세상에서 제일 ~한'이라는 뜻으로 일상에서 과장해서 자주 써요.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 너만큼 나한테 친언니 같았던 사람은 없어.
sentences.text: No one has been more like a sister to me.

alts.text: You've basically been my sister.
There is no one who has been more like a sister to me than you have.

sentences.note: **No one has been more like**는 '나한테 ~같은 사람으로는 네가 최고였어'라는 고마움의 표현이라 송별이나 결혼식 인사에 잘 어울립니다. **like a sister**는 피는 안 섞였어도 가족 같은 사이를 말해요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 이제 너희 다 내 손바닥 안이야.
sentences.text: I got you all right where I want you.

alts.text: You're all mine now.
Now I have all of you exactly where I want you.

sentences.note: **right where I want you** 는 상대가 꼼짝없이 내 뜻대로 될 처지에 놓였다는 말이에요. 보드게임이나 내기에서 이겼다 싶을 때 장난스럽게 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 자, 그냥 한 음절씩 끊어서 해 보자.
sentences.text: Okay, let's just let's try it one syllable at a time.

alts.text: One syllable at a time, okay?
Let us try saying it one syllable at a time.

sentences.note: **one syllable at a time** 은 어려운 단어 발음을 천천히 따라 하게 할 때 써요. **one ~ at a time** 은 '하나씩 차근차근'이라는 뜻으로 어디에나 붙여 쓸 수 있습니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.text: Well, we appreciate anything you can tell us.

alts.text: Anything helps, thanks.
We would be grateful for any information you are able to give us.

sentences.note: **anything you can tell us** 는 '아는 대로만 말해 줘도 된다'는 부드러운 부탁이에요. 앞에 **we appreciate** 를 붙여 미리 고마움을 표하면 상대가 부담 없이 입을 엽니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 걔도 속으로는 이미 알고 있는 거 아닐까?
sentences.text: Don't you think on some level he already knows?

alts.text: Bet deep down he already knows.
Do you not think that, on some level, he is already aware?

sentences.note: **on some level** 은 '겉으로는 몰라도 마음 한구석에서는'이라는 뜻이에요. **Don't you think** 로 시작하면 내 생각을 밀어붙이지 않고 슬쩍 떠보는 말이 됩니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 근데 우리 집엔 왜 맨날 잼이 없어?
sentences.text: Hey, how come we never have jam at our place?

alts.text: Why's there never any jam at ours?
Why is it that we never have any jam at home?

sentences.note: **how come** 은 why 보다 가볍게 '어째서 그래?' 하고 물을 때 써요. **at our place** 는 '우리 집에'를 말할 때 at home 만큼 자주 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends
